title: Affine Tracing: A New Paradigm for Probabilistic Linear Solvers
abstract: arXiv:2605.10566v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Probabilistic linear solvers (PLSs) return probability distributions that quantify uncertainty due to limited computation in the solution of linear systems. The literature has traditionally distinguished between Bayesian PLSs, which condition a prior on information obtained from projections of the linear system, and probabilistic iterative methods (PIMs), which lift classical iterative solvers to probability space. In this work we show this dichotomy to be false: Bayesian PLSs are a special case of non-stationary affine PIMs. In addition, we prove that any realistic affine PIM is calibrated. These results motivate a focus on (non-stationary) affine PIMs, but their practical adoption has been limited by the significant manual effort required to implement them. translated_title: 仿射追踪：概率线性求解器的新范式
translated_abstract: 概率线性求解器（PLSs）返回概率分布，用于量化求解线性系统时因计算资源有限而产生的不确定性。文献中传统上将贝叶斯PLS（其基于从线性系统投影中获得的信息对先验进行条件化）与概率迭代方法进行区分，后者将经典迭代求解器提升到概率空间。在本工作中，我们证明这种二分法是不成立的：贝叶斯PLS是非平稳仿射PIM的一种特例。此外，我们证明了任何现实的仿射PIM都是经过校准的。这些结果促使人们关注（非平稳）仿射PIM，但其实际应用一直受到实现它们所需的大量手工工作的限制。为解决这一问题，我们提出了仿射追踪，这是一种算法框架，能够通过仿射迭代方法的标准实现自动构建PIM……
tldr: 论文证明贝叶斯概率线性求解器只是非平稳仿射概率迭代方法的特例，并提出“仿射追踪”框架，能够从仿射迭代方法的标准实现中自动构建概率迭代方法，从而推动其广泛实际应用。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Bayesian probabilistic linear solvers are a special case of non-stationary affine probabilistic iterative methods and introduces "affine tracing," a framework that automatically constructs PIMs from standard implementations of affine iterative methods.
